title: Research Fellow Positions in Particle Physics
institution: Korea Institute for Advanced Study (KIAS), School of Physics
about: The Korea Institute for Advanced Study's School of Physics is recruiting postdoctoral Research Fellows in Particle Physics. Check the appointment terms on the official page. Applications close on 29 January 2027.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Postdoctoral research fellow" (research role in particle physics) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Research output of a fellowship → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
